purpose: Consumer-hardware matrix for the profile system: host classes, RAM/VRAM tiers, usable-memory formulas, engine-pin applicability, and every infeasible model x tier cell with its reason. Feasible cells get a profile file under configs/profiles/<model>/; infeasible cells get an entry here and no file.

spark.usable_model: ram_gib - floor_gib - 6 (OS reserve); cgroup accounting is blind to CUDA unified memory, the MemAvailable watchdog is the real guard
spark.detection: nvidia-smi reports GB10 and memory ~= MemTotal

mac.usable_model: min(0.75 * ram_gib, ram_gib - 8) at the default Metal wired limit; a raised_wired_limit mode (iogpu.wired_limit_mb sysctl) allows ram_gib - 10 on >= 96 GiB tiers - verify on hardware
mac.detection: darwin + arm64; ram via sysctl hw.memsize

dgpu.tier_semantics: tier is VRAM; profiles carry min_system_ram_gib separately
dgpu.usable_model: weights split across (vram_gib - 1.5) on-GPU plus system RAM; -ngl computed from VRAM; --no-mmap not forced
dgpu.detection: nvidia-smi memory.total much smaller than MemTotal

strix.usable_model: ram_gib - floor_gib - 6; GPU-visible memory (GTT) sizing per vendor/ds4/STRIXHALO.md section 3

fit_rule: weights_gib + draft_gib + context_cap * kv_bytes_per_token / 2^30 + overhead_gib + extra_gib <= usable_gib; within 5% of the ceiling is estimated-tight

deepseek-v4-flash.basis: analytic 6.9 KiB/token; the historical 4096 B admission constant in scripts/21_serve_llamacpp.sh is known-undersized and never used for estimation

qwen3.8-27b.basis: ~66 GB KV committed at 1M ctx f16 (results/qwen38-gates/trackc-1m-np4-2026-08-19/)

llamacpp-base-32e789fd.note: DSV4 baseline pin; the portable DSV4 engine

llamacpp-fusion-0dc74e33.note: fused DSV4 hyper-connection ops are CUDA-only ggml ops; Metal/ROCm use the base pin and record decode_baseline: pre-fusion

llamacpp-laguna-06f8cebd.note: poolside fork; Metal/HIP builds have no known fork CI - verify on hardware

ds4-baa88902.note: Makefile already multi-target (Darwin default = Metal, strix-halo, cpu). Pin predates upstream dd157bd (native sm_121 for cuda-spark); a pin bump is a separate owner evaluation

glm52-local-patches.note: patches/*.patch apply to ds4_cuda.cu only; GLM-5.2 is spark-only by definition
